summary: Comprehensive pre-launch QA audit across all 6 suites. 23/23 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend Playwright verified: Grace login, dashboard steps=15290, leaderboard Today (Grace #1 with 15,290 above Liam 12,430) & Week (Sofia 81,200 #1, Maya 76,500 #2) toggle re-orders correctly, session-expiry redirect + toast + localStorage clear, ChangePassword wrong-current-password no longer logs user out (iter21 regression fix confirmed). yarn typecheck: 0 errors on both frontend and server. NO issues found.

suites.suite1_grace_demo: PASS - login, steps=15290, podcastStreakCount=2, 3 seeded meals (Salad w/ wheat and white egg, Pumpkin soup, Quinoa Power Bowl), 7-day trends present
suites.suite2_isolation: PASS - new user starts steps=0, waterMl=0, empty trends, exactly 3 reminders copied from Grace template with correct states (meals=true, walk=true, water=false); Grace's data unchanged after new registration
suites.suite3_leaderboard: PASS - Grace rank=1 with steps=15290 on Today; new user replaces Grace on their own leaderboard (Grace not present); Today vs Week orderings differ; UI toggle verified visually (Today: Grace/Liam..., Week: Sofia 81200 / Maya 76500 ...)
suites.suite4_profile: PASS - goal preset PUT /user/profile persists (verified via GET); avatar accepts data:image/svg+xml URI and persists; password change round-trip (change to new -> old login fails -> new login works -> revert to 12345678 -> re-login works); wrong-current returns 401; UI regression: wrong-current keeps modal open on /profile (does NOT redirect to /login, iter21 fix confirmed)
suites.suite5_session_forgot: PASS - invalid JWT returns 401; UI: corrupted token in localStorage triggers redirect to /login + clears localStorage + shows 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.' toast. Forgot->reset round-trip returns resetToken, applies new password, reverts to 12345678; unknown email does NOT leak resetToken
suites.suite6_hygiene_security: PASS - /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/social, /auth/me, /user/profile responses recursively contain NO passwordHash/resetPasswordToken/resetPasswordExpires keys. yarn typecheck on /app/frontend and /app/server both report 0 errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Optional: /api/v1/auth/forgot-password currently returns resetToken in the response body when the email exists. Convenient for demo/testing but in a production deploy this should be removed (email delivery only) since it lets any caller reset any known email's password. Already noted 'no enumeration leak' for unknown emails which is good.
CommunityService leaderboard cleanly reorders by range (today uses live ActivityLog steps, week uses summed 7-day + friends' static weeklySteps). Rank assignment is deterministic.
User.toJSON transform correctly strips passwordHash/resetPasswordToken/resetPasswordExpires — verified across 5 endpoints recursively.
test_credentials: Grace: grace.user@email.com / 12345678 — VERIFIED intact at end of test run (both change-password round-trip and forgot->reset round-trip revert to 12345678 with post-revert login assertion).
seed_data_creation: One new test account per pytest run: qa.user.test.<uuid8>@vitality.demo (used for isolation + leaderboard replacement tests). Left in DB intentionally per user's request ('cleanup NOT required, wants isolation proven'). Second one-off account per hygiene test: qa.hygiene.<uuid6>@vitality.demo. Main agent may reseed if desired (npx ts-node /app/server/src/seed.ts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 QA suites pass cleanly. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_22.py is a comprehensive regression suite covering Grace data integrity, multi-tenant isolation, dynamic leaderboard (today & week), goal presets, avatar SVG data URI, password change round-trip (auto-reverts), session-expiry (invalid JWT 401), forgot/reset round-trip (auto-reverts), and secret-field hygiene across 5 auth/profile endpoints. Frontend session-expiry + change-password iter21 regression fix verified via Playwright.
